text_block_list.text:
One day, I spotted Daring Tact over by the 
academy's garden plot.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Ah, Tore-san! Good morning!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Yes. We just finished tilling, 
and everyone was leveling out the soil.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
We promised to have some tea together once 
we wrap up. 
We're almost done, so would you care to 
join us for a break, Tore-san?
choice_data_list:
In that case, let me lend a hand first, 
then I'd love to.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact's Classmate
text_block_list.text: Eeeek, so itchy, it's so itchy...!

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Ah... sorry for making a scene. I think a 
bug bit me. 
Ugh, I really should've brought bug 
spray...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Pardon me. Would you mind letting me take 
a look?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Yes. If we crush up some medicinal 
herbs and apply them, 
I think you will be just fine.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
I'm fairly sure mugwort grows over 
there... 
Please wait here a moment.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Whoa... the itching stopped!? 
Thanks, Daring Tact!
choice_data_list: You really know your herbs, don't you?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Hehe. Mugwort was something I relied on 
often in the mountains. 
It works wonders on scrapes and can be 
brewed into tea—it's a truly wonderful 
herb.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact's Classmate
text_block_list.text:
Man, Daring Tact, you're amazing. If I see 
wild weeds, all I ever think is, 'Oh look, 
grass.'

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Oh, no, I am simply borrowing the 
blessings of nature. 
It also repels bugs, so shall I apply a 
little more for you?

Daring Tact put her survival knowledge to 
good use even in academy life. 
And soon after, something else happened.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
...Tore-san. If I remember correctly, you 
were planning to head out later, weren't 
you? 
If so, please be sure to bring an 
umbrella.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: Most likely... it is going to rain soon.
choice_data_list:
My phone said it'd be clear all day, 
though...

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Please look at the sky. 
...Can you see that faint ring of light 
around the sun?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
That is a solar halo—in the mountains, 
seeing one is a sign that rain is coming. 
Whenever we saw it, we would hurry back to 
town or prepare to take shelter.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
And... above all else, I can sense it. 
A faint scent of moisture... the smell of 
rain.
choice_data_list: Does it... really smell like rain?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
So please, do take one. 
If you don't have one on hand, you are 
welcome to borrow mine...!
choice_data_list: N-No, I'm okay. I'll go grab mine.

text_block_list.text:
...Even so, the sky was completely clear. 
As I headed back to get an umbrella, 
I couldn't help but feel a little 
doubtful—
—Yet her prediction hit the bullseye.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
Ah, Tore-san. Um, were you alright? 
It turned into quite a heavy downpour, so 
I was worried you might have gotten 
soaked—
choice_data_list:
Mm-hm. Thanks to you, I stayed completely 
dry.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
You're very welcome. I'm glad I could be 
of help.

She possessed sharp senses distinctly 
different from the other girls. 
Far beyond merely having survival 
knowledge. Even previously—

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
............I am sorry, Tore-san. 
Would you mind if we turned back?

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
That tree over there... it appears to have 
'rub marks' on it.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text:
It's where a wild boar rubbed its body 
against the bark. 
And judged by the height, likely a 
considerably large one...

And—even in her running, 
Daring Tact's sharp instincts occasionally 
showed themselves.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: —...! Now! Right here—full throttle!

Just as if she was reading the exact 
moment to make her move 
entirely through her five senses.

text_block_list.name: Daring Tact
text_block_list.text: ...Is something the matter, Tore-san?

However, I had neither that knowledge nor 
those instincts. 
Which meant I wasn't seeing the same world 
she was.
choice_data_list:
(If I want to get closer to her 
perspective...)

text_block_list.text:
The place where those senses of hers were 
honed— 
That was, without a doubt, the nature of 
her hometown. In that case—

—Perhaps I should embrace the 'wild' 
myself.
